project.name: LAST SHIFT
project.workflow: fresh focused passes with controller validation

stories.title: Audit and stabilize the repository
Create the launchable shell and title flow
Implement basic player locomotion
Add advanced jumping mechanics
Add dodge, drop-through, and reset
Implement health, damage, death, and respawn
Implement the weapon framework and pistol
Complete Shambler combat contracts and death lifecycle
stories.objective: Finish the existing Shambler foundation without expanding perception or navigation scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Idle, investigate, chase, attack, stagger, and dead states are explicit and reset safely.
The Shambler accepts DamageInfo from pistol projectiles and dies exactly once.
Dead enemies ignore later damage and noise; reset restores a valid idle state.
Focused deterministic tests pass without weakening existing assertions.

recovery_hints: Signal-count tests in this project must use class-member counters rather than lambda-captured local integers.

stories.title: Implement Shambler sight and noise perception
stories.objective: Add deterministic distance, field-of-view, line-of-sight, and expiring noise memory.

acceptance_criteria.text: Sight requires range, configured field of view, and clear line of sight.
Gunfire noise starts investigation at the event position.
Last-known position expires deterministically and inactive enemies ignore events.
Focused perception tests cover visible, blocked, outside-FOV, and expired cases.

stories.title: Integrate Shambler pursuit and telegraphed attacks
stories.objective: Complete pursuit, attack telegraph, cooldown, player damage, and pistol combat integration.

acceptance_criteria.text: The Shambler pursues visible or remembered player positions and returns idle safely.
Attacks telegraph before applying damage and respect cooldown and range.
The enemy damages the player and can be killed by the pistol in an integration test.
Global validation passes with no parser or resource failures.

stories.title: Author arena traversal and checkpoint route
stories.objective: Create a complete entry-to-exit traversal route with stable checkpoint respawn.

acceptance_criteria.text: The player can traverse from entry to exit without debug intervention.
Static and one-way platforms are visually and physically distinct.
The authored checkpoint activates and respawns the player safely.

stories.title: Add moving platforms, hazards, and pickups
stories.objective: Add bounded arena interactions without changing the established route.

acceptance_criteria.text: At least one moving platform follows a deterministic authored path.
One hazard damages the player through the shared damage contract.
Health or ammunition pickup applies once and cleans itself up safely.

stories.title: Finish arena spawn points and side route
stories.objective: Complete enemy spawn metadata, an optional side route, and arena playability checks.

acceptance_criteria.text: Enemy spawn markers are authored and categorized.
An optional side route rejoins the critical path safely.
Traversal, hazards, pickups, and respawn pass one integrated arena check.

stories.title: Implement weapon inventory, reload, and switching
stories.objective: Establish magazines, reserve ammunition, reload authority, and safe switching.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reload completes exactly once and transfers bounded reserve ammunition.
Switching cannot bypass fire-rate or reload restrictions.
Weapon state remains correct after respawn.

stories.title: Add the shotgun
stories.objective: Add a data-driven shotgun without changing inventory authority.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shot emits the configured pellet count and spread.
Damage, knockback, ammunition, and cooldown remain bounded.
Deterministic tests cover spread limits and empty-magazine behavior.

stories.title: Add the automatic rifle
stories.objective: Add automatic fire and deterministic recoil recovery.

acceptance_criteria.text: Held input fires only at the configured automatic cadence.
Recoil accumulates and recovers within configured limits.
Reload and switching preserve rifle ammunition correctly.

stories.title: Add melee and weapon integration hooks
stories.objective: Add bounded melee interruption and stable state-reporting hooks for later HUD work.

acceptance_criteria.text: Melee respects range and cooldown and cannot damage repeatedly per swing.
Melee can interrupt eligible weak enemies without corrupting death state.
All weapons expose consistent ammunition, reload, equip, and state signals.

stories.title: Build authored platform navigation
stories.objective: Create a small authored platform graph with reachability and stuck recovery.

acceptance_criteria.text: Targets classify as reachable, blocked, jump, drop, or unreachable.
An enemy traverses one authored jump and one drop link.
Failed links trigger bounded stuck recovery instead of infinite retries.

stories.title: Add the Runner enemy
stories.objective: Add a fast close-range archetype using shared enemy contracts.

acceptance_criteria.text: Runner transitions and movement are distinct from the Shambler.
Its dangerous action has a visible deterministic telegraph.
Death, reset, perception, and navigation reuse shared contracts.

stories.title: Add the Spitter enemy
stories.objective: Add a telegraphed ranged archetype with bounded projectile behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: Spitter maintains its configured range and uses a telegraphed attack.
Enemy projectiles use shared damage ownership and clean up safely.
Blocked line of sight prevents ranged damage.

stories.title: Add the Brute and crowd separation
stories.objective: Add the heavy archetype and prevent exact enemy stacking.

acceptance_criteria.text: Brute attacks and stagger resistance are distinct and telegraphed.
Crowd separation prevents exact stacking without unstable impulses.
Mixed archetypes retain valid navigation, attack, and death states.

stories.title: Implement deterministic director budget and selection
stories.objective: Create seeded threat-budget accounting and capped enemy selection.

acceptance_criteria.text: A fixed seed reproduces budget and enemy-selection decisions.
Living-enemy and threat-budget caps cannot be exceeded.
Director logic is deterministic without rendering.

stories.title: Add safe spawning and encounter phases
stories.objective: Filter unsafe spawns and implement pressure and recovery phases.

acceptance_criteria.text: Visible or too-close spawn points are rejected.
Pressure escalates while bounded recovery periods remain possible.
Phase changes and spawn choices reproduce from a fixed seed.

stories.title: Build final holdout and victory flow
stories.objective: Integrate the director into a bounded final encounter with a clear victory condition.

acceptance_criteria.text: The holdout progresses through authored phases under director caps.
Completion reaches victory exactly once and stops further spawning.
Restarting the encounter clears prior enemies, timers, and signals.

stories.title: Create upgrade data and modifier runtime
stories.objective: Define upgrade data, stacks, exclusions, and apply-once modifier contracts.

acceptance_criteria.text: At least eight upgrades are represented as validated data.
Stack limits and mutual exclusions are enforced.
Runtime modifiers apply exactly once and survive checkpoint respawn.

stories.title: Implement deterministic upgrade choices
stories.objective: Produce reproducible valid choice sets from the session seed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A fixed seed reproduces the same three valid choices.
Maxed or excluded upgrades never appear.
Descriptions expose the numerical effects used by runtime modifiers.

stories.title: Add upgrade selection UI and integration
stories.objective: Present and apply one deterministic choice without duplicate application.

acceptance_criteria.text: The UI displays three choices and their numerical effects.
Selecting once applies one upgrade and closes the choice state.
Scene reload and checkpoint respawn do not apply upgrades twice.

stories.title: Define versioned save schema and sanitization
stories.objective: Create a versioned boundary that validates missing, corrupt, old, and invalid data.

acceptance_criteria.text: Save data contains an explicit version and only stable identifiers.
Missing, corrupt, unknown, and invalid fields fall back safely.
Sanitization and migration logic is deterministic and unit tested.

stories.title: Implement save round trip for gameplay state
stories.objective: Persist and reconstruct checkpoint, weapons, upgrades, encounters, and seed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A save/load round trip preserves every required stable field.
Runtime nodes reconstruct from sanitized data instead of serialized objects.
Loading cannot duplicate upgrades, ammunition, or encounter completion.

stories.title: Add New Game, Continue, and clear-save flows
stories.objective: Integrate safe save lifecycle actions into title and checkpoint flow.

acceptance_criteria.text: New Game starts clean and Continue reflects valid save availability.
Continue and checkpoint restart reconstruct the expected state.
Clear-save removes availability and repeated lifecycle cycles remain clean.

stories.title: Build gameplay HUD and state menus
stories.objective: Add signal-driven health, ammunition, weapon, reload, encounter, death, and victory UI.

acceptance_criteria.text: HUD reports health, ammunition, weapon, reload, and encounter state.
Pause, death, victory, and options states are navigable.
Repeated scene and pause cycles do not duplicate UI or signals.

stories.title: Centralize camera and combat feedback
stories.objective: Compose camera shake, hit stop, and transient visual feedback safely.

acceptance_criteria.text: Concurrent shake requests combine predictably within configured limits.
Hit stop restores time scale exactly once.
Transient effects release nodes and signals after repeated combat.

stories.title: Implement managed audio architecture
stories.objective: Provide bounded reusable audio emitters and stable category controls.

acceptance_criteria.text: Transient sounds reuse or release emitters without node growth.
Music, effects, and UI categories expose stable volume controls.
Scene changes stop or retain audio according to explicit ownership.

stories.title: Add debug overlay and performance counters
stories.objective: Expose isolated diagnostics that can be disabled for production.

acceptance_criteria.text: Overlay reports FPS, enemies, projectiles, director, player, weapon, checkpoint, and seed.
Debug actions are isolated from production input and can be disabled.
Counters do not perform repeated broad scene-tree searches each frame.

stories.title: Run integration and lifecycle audit
stories.objective: Repair cross-system lifecycle defects and verify the playable vertical slice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Import, startup, tests, and title-to-victory flow pass.
Repeated scene, death, pause, save, and victory cycles do not duplicate state.
Core systems have automated checks or explicit reproducible manual checks.

stories.title: Finalize documentation and release baseline
stories.objective: Align durable documentation with the validated implementation and record known limitations.

acceptance_criteria.text: README, architecture, testing, and progress documents match the build.
Required features are not represented by deceptive placeholders.
Known limitations, risky files, and release validation are recorded.
The final repository is clean and global validation passes.
